personality_one_liner: A clean, friendly, and deeply tactile utility interface that makes device optimization feel safe, satisfying, and effortless.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing inside cards for a friendly, uncrowded feel. Outer padding consistently lg (16pt). Maintain tight groupings for lists.

do's: Use on the bottom tab bar when content scrolls beneath it
Use for sticky bottom CTA containers (e.g., 'Clean' button pinned to bottom)
Use for sticky headers when scrolling lists like large files or duplicate photos
dont's: Do not use glass on the white dashboard cards or tool grid items
Do not apply blur to the main circular gauges or progress bars

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provides an immediate at-a-glance health score and quick entry points to core optimization tools.

states.error: Card showing 'Unable to scan device' with a primary 'Retry' pill button.

screens.layout: Headerless or simple text header. Central visual: Large circular gauge (0-100 score) with a bold green ring, score in the center, and a subtle subtitle below. Directly beneath is a large 'Optimise' pill button. Below that, a 2x2 grid of white rounded cards (shadow tier 2) representing 'Clean Up', 'Viruses', etc. Each card contains a prominent colored circular icon chip (e.g., blue for storage, orange for risks). A 'Tools' row follows below the grid.

screens.name: Junk / Clean Up
screens.purpose: Guides the user to free up storage by reviewing and clearing cache, duplicates, and large files.

states.loading: Scanning animation playing inside the storage card.
states.empty: Illustration of a clean box with 'Your phone is spotless!'
states.error: Error reading storage message with a 'Try Again' button.

screens.layout: Large numeric header showing freeable space (e.g., '2.86 GB'). Below is a storage capacity card with a segmented progress bar. Content below is a list of 'Recommended cleanup' categories with individual 'Ignore/Clean' pill controls. A sticky, full-width glass-backed bottom container holds the primary 'Clean' CTA.

screens.name: Optimise
screens.purpose: A checklist of quick-win performance improvements the user can execute sequentially or all at once.

states.empty: All tasks completed state with a success badge.

screens.layout: Simple top gauge showing the current state ('Good - 98 pts'). A list of optimization rows. Each row features a brightly colored circle icon, a title/subtitle, and a light grey 'Go' pill button. 'Done' button pinned at the bottom.

screens.name: Viruses & risks
screens.purpose: A dedicated security scan view showcasing device safety status and scan history.

states.loading: Pulsing concentric green rings around the security shield.
states.error: Red 'Scan failed' state with retry action.

screens.layout: A large green 'Secure' heading. A hero visual of a big green circular badge with a shield/lightning icon and concentric rings. Below are white cards detailing 'Scan records' and settings like 'Auto scan'. Sticky 'Scan Again' button at the bottom.

screens.name: Tools
screens.purpose: A categorized grid of all secondary utilities and privacy features available in the app.
screens.layout: A scrollable view sectioned by headers ('Cleanup & boost', 'Privacy', 'App security'). Under each header, tools are arranged in a 2-column or list layout. Each tool uses a white rounded card with a dedicated colored circular icon to maintain the tactile/playful aesthetic.

onboarding_optimization.alt: 3D playful cleaning tools indicating phone optimization

security_shield.alt: A 3D security shield representing virus protection

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the '4 Tactile / Playful' personality but restricted strictly to the defined Utility color palette (Avast Green, Light Grey background, White Cards). Do not introduce pastels outside of the defined tokens.
The primary action buttons must be fully rounded 'pill' buttons with generous height (min 56pt), conveying friendliness and approachability.
Cards should use surfaceSecondary (white) sitting on surface (light grey) with shadow_tier 2 to create a soft, lifted look.
Icons within cards should be placed inside circular colored chips (use info/warning/error/brand tokens as the background color for these chips, depending on the tool category).
Circular gauges are central to this design. Ensure they use smooth SVGs or Reanimated, with the 'brand' (Avast Green) driving the progress ring.

Implement sticky CTAs (e.g. 'Clean' or 'Optimise' buttons) at the bottom of scrolling screens using a glass-effect container (or solid white if on low-end Android) to ensure they are always reachable.
Never use generic blue/indigo as the default accent. Stick strictly to the defined brand hex (#38A845) and the supporting vibrant status colors.
